Package com.teragrep.cfe_16.event.time.candidates

Interface HECTimestampCandidate

All Known Implementing Classes:
DecimalCandidate, HECTimestampCandidateImpl, MicrosPrecisionCandidate, MillisPrecisionCandidate, NanosPrecisionCandidate, PeriodSuffixCandidate, SecondsPrecisionCandidate
public interface HECTimestampCandidate
Checks if the given timestamp string matches the format expected by the HECTimestampCandidate object. If it matches, an Instantiable implementation object will be returned. Otherwise, a stub object is returned.
